confirm_server.description:
The server at {host} is not the one this integration was set up with. It reports CAN address {mac}.

Continue only if you replaced your M-SERV, or if you meant to point this integration at another one. Your devices and your entities keep their ids, their areas, and any name you gave them yourself. They bind to the objects of the new server's Designer project.
confirm_server.title: A different Ampio server

reauth_confirm.description: The Ampio server rejected the stored credentials for {name}. Enter the credentials to use.
reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Ampio

reconfigure.description: Change the address or the account this integration uses. Your devices and your entities keep their ids, their areas, and any name you gave them yourself.
reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Ampio

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the Ampio server (M-SERV).

user.description: Enter the address and credentials of your Ampio server. A standard user account is recommended. An administrator account additionally provides per-module device information and faster state updates.
user.title: Connect to Ampio

cannot_connect.message: Cannot connect to the Ampio server.

discovery_timeout.message: Connected to the Ampio server, but it did not finish reporting its configuration.

invalid_auth.message: The Ampio server rejected the stored credentials.

module_not_addressable.message: The Ampio server lists no address for this module, so the identify frame cannot be sent.

read_only_object.message: This object is marked read-only in Ampio Designer, and the server drops every write to it.

records_unavailable.message: Connected to the Ampio server, but it did not answer the module description request.
